The change in `KeepWordFilter.java` complements the updates in the filter factories by ensuring that the token processing logic aligns with the new data structure used for storing words, thus maintaining the integrity and performance of the filtering process.

The addition of tests in `TestUtils.java` serves to validate the changes made in the filter factories, ensuring that the new implementations function correctly and efficiently.
